[217.02s] Turn off the food processor by rotating the dial using the left hand counter-clockwise.
-> CONTEXT: The person turns the dial of the food processor to stop it.
-> STATE: The food processor was turned off.

[218.13s] Flip the orange half towards the camera to check that all the juice has been removed.
-> CONTEXT: The person flips an orange half to inspect it.
-> STATE: The orange half was flipped to check for remaining juice.

[218.64s] open the lid of the food recycling bin using the left hand.
-> CONTEXT: The person opens a bin with a lid.
-> STATE: SKIP (This is about a container, not food).

[219.42s] throw the half orange skin inside the food processing bin using the right hand.
-> CONTEXT: The person discards an orange peel into a bin.
-> STATE: The orange peel was thrown into the food recycling bin.

[220.62s] Pick up the second orange from the countertop using the right hand.
-> CONTEXT: The person picks an orange from the counter.
-> STATE: The orange was picked up from the countertop.

[221.17s] Place the orange on the chopping board.
-> CONTEXT: The person places the orange on a cutting board.
-> STATE: The orange was placed on the chopping board.

[221.79s] Pick up the knife from the chopping board.
-> CONTEXT: The person picks a knife from the board.
-> STATE: SKIP (This is about a tool, not food).

[222.27s] holding the orange using the left hand, slice the orange into two halves using a sewing-like motion of the knife using the right hand.
-> CONTEXT: The person cuts an orange in half on a board.
-> STATE: The orange was sliced into two halves.

[224.56s] Put down the knife on the chopping board.
-> CONTEXT: The person sets a knife down on the board.
-> STATE: SKIP (This is about a tool, not food).

[225.14s] Pick up one of the halves of the orange using the left hand and pass it to the right hand.
-> CONTEXT: The person transfers an orange half from one hand to the other.
-> STATE: The orange half was transferred from the left hand to the right hand.

[225.69s] Flip the half of the orange using the right hand, place it downwards, facing downwards, on the cone of the juice processor.
-> CONTEXT: The person positions an orange half on a juicer cone.
-> STATE: The orange half was placed on the juicer cone.

[226.22s] Switch the food processor on using the dial with the left hand rotating it clockwise.
-> CONTEXT: The person turns on the food processor.
-> STATE: The food processor was turned on.

[226.85s] Press the orange half using both hands, right hand on the orange and left hand on the right hand, pressing it downwards on the cone of the juicer.
-> CONTEXT: The person presses an orange half into the juicer.
-> STATE: The orange half was pressed into the juicer.

[235.84s] Turn the food processor off by rotating the dial using the left hand counter-clockwise.
-> CONTEXT: The person turns off the food processor.
-> STATE: The food processor was turned off.

[238.05s] Open the lid of the food recycling bin using the left hand and remove the orange from the cone of the juicer using the right hand.
-> CONTEXT: The person opens a bin and removes an orange from the juicer.
-> STATE: The orange was removed from the juicer cone.

[238.72s] throw the half skin orange from the right hand inside the food recycling bin.
-> CONTEXT: The person discards an orange peel into a bin.
-> STATE: The orange peel was thrown into the food recycling bin.

[239.49s] Pick up the second half of the second orange using the right hand from the chopping board.
-> CONTEXT: The person picks up the remaining orange half.
-> STATE: The second half of the orange was picked up from the chopping board.
